Challenge.title: Challenge
Challenge.description: Shared savings challenge for the couple

targetAmount.description: Total target amount to save in Brazilian Reais

partner1Uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the first partner

partner2Uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the second partner

inviteCode.description: Short code to join the challenge on another device

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the challenge was created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the challenge was last updated

Deposit.title: Deposit
Deposit.description: Deposit marked for a specific number from 1 to 200

number.description: The number slot in the 200 grid (1 to 200)

amount.description: Monetary value saved for this slot in BRL

depositedBy.description: Identifier of the partner who saved this amount

depositedByName.description: Display name of the person who made the deposit

depositDate.description: Date of deposit formatted as YYYY-MM-DD

notes.description: Optional notes or message regarding the deposit

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who registered the deposit

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the deposit was registered

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the deposit was last updated

/challenges/{challengeId}.description: Shared challenge entity containing partner names and goal configuration

/challenges/{challengeId}/deposits/{depo.description: Subcollection of 200 numbers marked by the couple
